messages:
Ava (CEO): Quick weekly steward note — concise: Private GA on track, brief incident review, two policy items, and three operational asks. Please skim and action where relevant. :sparkles:
Miguel (VP Eng): Private GA smoke passed in staging. 99p latency gap narrowed to ~8% vs target. Working on batching/kv tweaks; expect further drop after PRs land.
Rae (VP Product): GA launch playbook is in the console doc; outstanding blocker: billing edge cases when customers mix dedicated + hosted. Legal and Sales looped.
Sam (Head of SRE): Incident recap (last night): autoscaler mis-schedule triggered by a transient zone flapping event. Impact window ~4 minutes with elevated 5xx on some dedicated pools in us-west-2. Fallback to hosted worked as designed. Actions: adjusted node health check thresholds, added secondary fallback rule, and added a metric alert for autoscaler jitter. Full postmortem posted to #postmortems by EOD.
Ava (CEO): Appreciate the quick mitigation. Miguel, can you file a short RFC for a one-click rollback in the Console with telemetry guardrails? We want an explicit playbook there.
Miguel (VP Eng): Will do. RFC + design draft by Tues EOD.
Dana (People Ops): Two policy updates: 1) On-call window shift: 8am-5pm PT (from 9-6) to improve APAC overlap. 2) Hosted API log retention default extended to 30 days (from 14d) to aid customer investigations. Managers must acknowledge within 72h. Handbook link in the follow-up.
Rae (VP Product): We'll send customers a note on retention and GA timing. No pricing changes.
Ava (CEO): Metrics at-a-glance: weekly MRR +2.1%, hosted API RPS +6% w/w, chat 99p latency improved ~3% after batching. Cost per 1k tokens down ~1.8%. Keep focusing on latency/cost tradeoffs.
Miguel (VP Eng): Engineering asks: 1) Target -10% 99p latency for chat within 4 weeks. 2) Land remaining quantization PRs to reduce memory on dedupe workloads.
Sam (Head of SRE): Ops asks: volunteers for incident rotation — need two people to cover May. Also, review security PR for probe threshold changes in 30m.
Ava (CEO): Hiring note: lifting hiring pause for product & infra roles up to IC4. Exceptions via VP.
Rae (VP Product): Private GA soft open next Thu to a small partner cohort. Full public GA aimed two weeks later if stable.
deploy-bot: Pipeline: private-ga/v1.0 -> green. Canary at 20% across us-west and eu-west. No failed jobs.
Miguel (VP Eng): Console TODO: expose KV cache TTL toggle for Dedicated customers; adding item to GA checklist.
Ava (CEO): Two process asks: 1) Postmortems must start with a one-paragraph customer impact summary. 2) Policy change requests must include rollback criteria. Makes exec reviews faster.
Dana (People Ops): FYI all-hands Friday 9:30am PT — founders AMA on GA and incident learnings.
Ava (CEO): Any blockers?
Rae (VP Product): None from Product.
Miguel (VP Eng): On track; RFC + rollout work today.
Sam (Head of SRE): Need quick Security review on the probe thresholds PR.
Ava (CEO): Great. Short week, high focus. Thanks team. :raised_hands:
